universal_motto: EVERYTHING HAPPENING IS AN EVENT, AND ALL EVENTS HAVE INTENT
purpose: Make every processed example/event leave a traceable growth contribution against existing IDs, live intent signatures, patterns and memory without confusing occurrence counts with validated truth or canonical promotion.

count_layers.meaning: Raw event/example was processed and preserved with provenance. This count can grow without semantic approval.
Existing Container/Rubric/Parameter IDs were activated as runtime candidates. Activation frequency is not truth or importance.
A live intent/pattern signature received another candidate contribution. Contradictions and alternatives remain attached.
Support only increases after required review/evidence contract accepts the contribution for its scope.
New approved IDs/patterns/rubrics require explicit review and applicable R-F-R/promotion gates.

atomic_parameter_activation.rule: Only exact-name auto matches may feed live intent in V1.3. Fuzzy/token-overlap candidates are displayed for review but do not alter intent generation.

event_intent_policy.natural_event_guard: Use NATURAL_DYNAMICS_DIRECTION or UNKNOWN; never fabricate conscious agency.
event_intent_policy.represented_case_guard: Intent generated from event structure is DERIVED_INTENT_HYPOTHESIS unless directly evidenced or user-attributed.
